# WebCraft

> WebCraft builds custom websites for small businesses and offers optional hosting and maintenance, local SEO, Google Ads management, and Google Analytics 4 setup. WebCraft is based near Cleveland, Tennessee, and works remotely with businesses in Tennessee, Georgia, and North Carolina.

The standard website package costs $500 one time for up to five pages, including a custom design, mobile layouts, a contact form, and basic on-page SEO. The customer owns the website files. Payment is 50% to start and 50% on delivery. Extra pages are $50 each. Optional hosting and care for the standard website is $20 per month. Domain fees, third-party subscriptions, and marketing work are separate.

Local SEO, Google Ads, and analytics work are quoted after reviewing the scope. Google Ads spend is paid directly to Google. WebCraft works by phone, email, and online reviews. The location links describe service coverage.

## Services and pricing

- [Web design and redesign](https://localwebcraft.com/web-design.html): Standard website package, pricing, and what to send for a quote.
- [Website hosting and maintenance](https://localwebcraft.com/web-hosting.html): Optional monthly care, agreed content updates, domain connections, and help assessing a hosting move.
- [Local SEO](https://localwebcraft.com/local-seo.html): Local search audits, service page improvements, Business Profile guidance for eligible businesses, and reporting.
- [Google Ads management](https://localwebcraft.com/google-ads.html): Paid search campaigns, account reviews, location targeting, tracking, and separate ad spend.
- [GA4 and conversion tracking](https://localwebcraft.com/analytics.html): Google Analytics 4 and Search Console setup, form and contact tracking, testing, and reporting.

## Contact and next steps

- [Request a quote](https://localwebcraft.com/#contact): Share your business name, city, the service you need, and a brief description of the project.
- [Request a free website snapshot](https://localwebcraft.com/free-website-snapshot.html): Ask for a brief review of your existing website and suggested fixes.
- [About WebCraft](https://localwebcraft.com/about.html): Meet Mike Stephen, the web designer behind WebCraft.
- [Email WebCraft](mailto:Hello@localwebcraft.com): Project and service inquiries.
- [Call WebCraft](tel:+14234018663): (423) 401-8663.
